permissionBasis: Data Dragon is explicitly allowed by Riot developer policies. Use is conditional on those policies, not individual written approval. Owner must confirm Developer Portal registration and audit of this update; this was not accessible in this session.

scenes.source: Original environment generated for this project, not official League terrain
scenes.movement: Bounded vertical reveal of landscape with separately masked foreground right edge; no unlimited zoom or invented 3D flight
Individual compositions using unmodified official base splash artwork, all choices labeled, art and text in separate layout columns
Original HTML/CSS rank-value bars, zero baseline, fixed scale across Before/After; icons never larger than native size
Staggered ensemble on original typographic green field, saved/candidate labels and actual persistent store

data.verification: All before/after rank values matched official page on review date.

fonts: Existing licensed General Sans and Clash Display; licenses remain in src/assets/fonts
excluded: No extracted models, cinematic clips, music, unofficial champion redesigns, or igloo assets.
